inputs.brief:
Accounts payable specialist in Abu Dhabi, on site.
Needs 3 years of AP, UAE VAT invoices and an ERP like SAP or Oracle.
Accounting qualification and Arabic are a plus. Salary hidden.

response.description_ar:
عن الوظيفة
ستعالج فواتير الموردين لمكاتبنا في أبوظبي وتتأكد من أن كل دفعة صحيحة ومعتمدة وفي موعدها.

ماذا ستفعل
- تدقيق فواتير الموردين وترميزها.
- مطابقة الفواتير مع أوامر الشراء والإيصالات.
- تجهيز دفعات المدفوعات للاعتماد.

ما تحتاجه
- خبرة 3 سنوات في الحسابات الدائنة.
- معرفة جيدة بفواتير ضريبة القيمة المضافة في الإمارات.
- خبرة في نظام تخطيط موارد مثل SAP أو Oracle.

ميزة إضافية
- مؤهل محاسبي معترف به.
- التحدث بالعربية.
response.description_en:
About the role
You will process supplier invoices for our offices in Abu Dhabi and make sure every payment is correct, approved and on time.

What you will do
- Check and code supplier invoices.
- Match invoices to purchase orders and receipts.
- Prepare payment runs for approval.
- Answer supplier questions by email and phone.

What you need
- 3 years of experience in accounts payable.
- Good knowledge of UAE VAT invoices.
- Experience with an ERP system such as SAP or Oracle.

Nice to have
- A recognised accounting qualification.
- Spoken Arabic.
requirements: 3 years of experience in accounts payable.
Good knowledge of UAE VAT invoices.
Experience with an ERP system such as SAP or Oracle.
responsibilities: Match invoices to purchase orders and receipts.
Answer supplier questions by email and phone.
response.summary: You will process supplier invoices and prepare payments. You will make sure every payment is correct and approved.
response.title: Accounts Payable Specialist

inputs.description:
About the role
You will lead a team of eight support agents who help drivers and customers by chat and phone. You can work from anywhere in the UAE.

What you will do
- Coach the team and plan shifts.
- Handle complex cases and complaints.
- Track response times and customer satisfaction.
- Improve our help articles with the product team.

What you need
- Experience leading a customer support team.
- Fluent English and Arabic, written and spoken.
- Experience with a help desk tool such as Zendesk or Freshdesk.

Nice to have
- Experience in logistics or delivery.

inputs.description:
About the role
You will build and run the services that plan deliveries for our customers across the UAE. You join a team of six engineers who own their services from design to production.

What you will do
- Design, build and test Python services and APIs.
- Run services on Kubernetes and keep them healthy in production.
- Review code and help teammates grow.
- Work with product and operations to plan changes.

What you need
- 5 years of experience building backend services in Python.
- Experience running services on Kubernetes in production.
- Good knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL.
- Clear written English for design documents and reviews.

Nice to have
- Experience with event streaming such as Kafka.
- Spoken or written Arabic.

knockout_questions.question: Do you have the right to work in the UAE, or will you need a visa from us?
knockout_questions.question_ar: هل لديك حق العمل في الإمارات، أم ستحتاج إلى تأشيرة منا؟
knockout_questions.reason: We can sponsor visas for this role, but a person needs to plan it.

must_haves.description: Has built and maintained backend services in Python for several years.
must_haves.evidence: Names Python services or APIs they built, with their role and how long.
must_haves.name: Python backend services

must_haves.description: Has run services on Kubernetes in production.
must_haves.evidence: Describes deploying or operating a production workload on Kubernetes.
must_haves.name: Kubernetes in production

must_haves.description: Designs schemas and writes efficient SQL for PostgreSQL.
must_haves.evidence: Mentions PostgreSQL work such as schema design, queries or tuning.
must_haves.name: PostgreSQL and SQL

must_haves.description: Writes clear design documents and code reviews in English.
must_haves.evidence: The CV and answers are clear; mentions design docs or reviews.
must_haves.name: Clear written English

nice_to_haves.description: Has used event streaming such as Kafka.
nice_to_haves.evidence: Mentions Kafka or a similar system in a project.
nice_to_haves.name: Event streaming

nice_to_haves.evidence: Lists Arabic as a language they speak or write.
nice_to_haves.name: Arabic
